messages:
Lina: Heads-up: final checklist for Friday's mini-lab registration + replay delivery. Need to lock consent language, caption cleanup owner, edit SLA, and email A/B subjects.
Arjun: I can draft consent copy. We should be explicit: recordings reused for marketing, attendees can opt out, and we must surface data retention timeframe.
Fiona: I'll own caption cleanup and speaker diarization. Plan: run Zoom VTT through our transcript-normalizer, then generate a speaker map and short summary bullets for the replay page.
Ben: Editing capacity Q: how fast can we turn around 4 clips + full edit? We promised 48 hours. I can do 24h for highlights if someone verifies timestamps quickly.
Lina: 48h SLA is fine, but let's aim for 36h for the full replay. Ben -> confirm you can do 36h for the full edit.
Ben: Confirmed 36h for full replay if raw files and transcript are in S3 within 2h of event end. Otherwise falls back to 72h.
Arjun: Consent draft suggestion: "By registering you consent to recording and limited reuse of session material for product and educational content. Recordings are stored for 30 days and accessible to registrants via a secure link. To opt out, reply to this email." Thoughts?
Fiona: Add a line about sensitive info: "If you share sensitive or customer-identifying data during Q&A it may be redacted on request." Also we should not promise unlimited public reuse.
Arjun: Updated: "Recordings stored 30 days; snippets may be used for marketing; registrants can request redaction or opt-out."
Lina: Good. For HubSpot field mapping: use form field 'consent_recording' boolean, 'consent_marketing_use' boolean, and 'preferred_replay_time' enum. Fiona/Jules (cc) ensure these map to contact properties.
Fiona: Noted. I'll coordinate with Ops to ensure webhook payloads include consent flags.
EventBot: Zoom meeting 99887766 started recording -> 2815000450 (system).
EventBot: Cloud recording complete -> 2815000500. Exported to s3://redwood-marketing/mini-lab-2026/raw/2815000500/ ; transcript: s3://redwood-marketing/mini-lab-2026/raw/2815000500/transcript.vtt
Ben: Received S3 export. Starting ingest job for clips. Posting timestamps channel when ready.
Fiona: Transcript ingest passed; running normalization. Expect speaker map + summary in ~40m.
Lina: Email subjects for A/B test — short vs narrative. A) "Mini-lab replay: ship low-latency LLM features" B) "Missed the mini-lab? Watch the hands-on demo + clips" Which should be variant A?
Arjun: A = short (A), B = narrative. Suggest we send to 20% of registrants each for subject test, remainder get winner after 6h.
Ben: Clips plan: highlight 15s, demo 45s, architecture 90s. Tag clips with timestamps in S3 and a JSON manifest. I will create editor perms for @fiona by EOD.
Fiona: Editor perms granted. I'll pull clips and run the speaker-label pass. Need to confirm license for background music on highlight.
Lina: Use only royalty-free music from our library; marketing ops has the license list.
Arjun: One more compliance note: Preflight legal approval required for any clip used externally. Tag 'legal_review_required' true in manifest if clip contains product roadmap or customer mentions.
Ben: Adding 'legal_review_required' field to manifest schema.
EventBot: Post-processing job complete -> 2815000850. Manifest: s3://redwood-marketing/mini-lab-2026/processed/2815000850/manifest.json :white_check_mark:
Lina: Awesome. Next steps: 1) Publish replay page with consent flags 2) Kick HubSpot replay workflow 3) Start A/B subject test 4) Notify sales with engaged list. Ping here once done.
Arjun: Consent copy published on LP.
Fiona: Caption cleaned + speaker map uploaded. Summary bullets attached to replay page.
Ben: Clips uploaded and manifest in place. Editing SLA: full replay in 34h (ahead of 36h).
Lina: :tada: Closing loop. We'll debrief on Monday re: open rates and clip engagement. If any blockers, post here.
